exact_statement: For actual Boolean children g and h=g(1-2*1_D) on m uniform bits, nonempty D of s vertices and E(D) internal unordered edges, d=s*2^-m and c_D=I(gh)/2=2^-m(ms-2E(D)), and c_D+log2(e)*d-B equals 2^-m(s log2(s)-2E(D)) + [d+(1-d)ln(1-d)]/ln2 + I(Z;T), with Z the selector spectral bit and T the residual label. For quadratic bent core b on even k>=4 and a one-point activation on r>=0 controls, actual selector surgery F has I(F)=2^-r[k/2+r(1-2^(-k/2))+2^-k(A_D+r S_D+s)], with S_D=sum_D b(v) and A_D=sum_(v in D,i:v^i notin D)b(v)b(v^i). For alpha=s*2^-k<1/2, c_D/I(F)<=2alpha/(1-2alpha). Every fair constant-child split obeys B/d<=2+log2(e)/sqrt(e)<3, so control-first activation creates no threshold-4 bad-node credit and scales the full active core ledger by 2^-r. Exact exhaustion of k=4, r in {0,2,4}, all D of sizes 1..4 and four named complete orders gives maximum Q_bad,4/I=4/29 at D={15},r=0,selector-first or control-first, while control-data-selector has zero bad-node credit for every such D and every integer r>=0. For D3={2,4,6} and D4={2,4,6,11}, the data-first descendant after x0=0 querying x1 is bad for every r>=1; its B/d is at least [112-54log2(3)+80log2(5)-98log2(7)+26log2(13)]/8 in (4157/1000,4158/1000). The full data-first bad-node ratio is at least (r+3)/(35+15r) or (r+3)/(34+14r), respectively. These are scoped root/ledger claims, not a universal stopping-tree payment or an FEI disproof.
